description: This file contains SwiftUI-based test cases for the OpenClaw iOS/macOS application, specifically testing the behavior of gateway discovery menu and list views within the application's UI using the testing framework.

classes.name: MasterDiscoveryMenuSmokeTests
classes.description: A struct defining a suite of UI tests for the gateway discovery menu components in the OpenClaw application.

methods.name: inline list builds body when empty
methods.description: Test for verifying the construction of the InlineList view when there are no gateways discovered.

methods.name: inline list builds body with master and selection
methods.description: Test for verifying the InlineList view with a single discovered gateway and a selected target.

methods.name: menu builds body with masters
methods.description: Test for verifying the GatewayDiscoveryMenu view populates correctly with multiple gateways.
